description: Every repo in its place, every agent on the same page: project context and handoff notes, tasks, a portfolio overview, local-first delivery (one push, one CI run), backend methodology, managed worktrees and a guard.

interface.shortDescription: Every repo in its place. Every agent on the same page.
interface.longDescription: devkit keeps every project in its place and every session in context: handoff notes and tasks per project, a portfolio overview and dashboard, local-first delivery with one push and one CI run, backend methodology, managed worktrees and a workspace guard. Installed and kept in sync by the `dev` CLI.
